research_question: Who bears losses when an AI agent with bank access makes an unwanted payment, and what evidence and controls decide it?

research_brief.purpose: Explain agentic banking liability with verified regulatory and supervisory sources.
research_brief.audience: US bank customers and fintech readers.
research_brief.data_period: Speeches Sept 28 and Nov 16, 2026; HKMA Nov 2, 2026; BIS Nov 4, 2026; IMF March 2024; American Banker Oct 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: No court rulings or loss data on agent payments; liability analysis is illustrative.
